bio.text: Fredrick J. Love represents District 15 in the Arkansas Senate, which includes parts of Little Rock and Pulaski County; he was elected in 2022 and sworn in on January 9, 2023.
Ballotpedia lists Love as the Democratic nominee for Governor of Arkansas in 2026.
Love served in the Arkansas House of Representatives from 2011 through 2022.

He earned a bachelor's degree in political science and a master's degree in public administration from the University of Arkansas at Little Rock, and attended the Harvard Kennedy School for Senior Executives in State and Local Government.
